# Install and first run

Read [the five calls](calls.md#launch) next, or start [the tutorial](tutorial/01-cube.md).
The [cards example](../examples/cards/main.roc) is a whole game.

![A cube on a grey floor](images/cube.png)

```roc
app [init] { pf: platform "{{platform_url}}", roc: "{{roc_nightly}}" }
```
